description: Assign an executor line as the maintainer of one module. The line must be an executor line in the same project; if another line already maintains the module, the maintainer role transfers to the named line. Under every-step confirmation the call stops at a waiting operation and answers needs_decision with a maintainer_assignment cardKey for the person; under automatic confirmation it assigns the line and answers assigned. Parameters: moduleRef names the module, sessionRef names the executor line, and reason says why that line should maintain it (1-2000 UTF-8 bytes).

parameters.moduleRef: The module to maintain: {projectId, moduleId}; both ids are non-empty strings.
parameters.sessionRef: The executor line to assign: {projectId, sessionId}; both ids are non-empty strings.
parameters.reason: Why this line should maintain the module; 1-2000 UTF-8 bytes.
